title: Star button
description: A button for starring an item, with a counter. The star morphs into a filled one when you press it, and the count goes up.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: The button and its icon
fragments.note: The icon, the stylesheet and the count all read aria-pressed.

fragments.title: Flip the attribute on click
fragments.note: No lock, and no mention of an icon.

fragments.title: Colour from the same attribute
fragments.note: One custom property, four states. The icon inherits it through current-color.
